description: This is a test class for the UserService in a book tracking application. It contains unit tests for user registration, retrieval, modification, deletion, and account locking functionalities, utilizing Mockito and JUnit 5.

classes.name: UserServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for UserService, testing user registration, retrieval, modification, deletion, and account locking functionalities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the UserService instance with mocked dependencies before each test.

methods.name: register_throwsNullPointerException_ifUserIsNull
methods.description: Tests that registering a null user throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: findUserById_searchesRepository
methods.description: Verifies that findUserById calls the repository's findById method.

methods.name: findUserById_throwsNullPointerException_ifIdIsNull
methods.description: Tests that passing null to findUserById throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: findUserByEmail_searchesRepository
methods.description: Verifies that findUserByEmail calls the repository's findByEmail method.

methods.name: findUserByEmail_throwsNullPointerException_ifEmailIsNull
methods.description: Tests that passing null to findUserByEmail throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: isEmailInUse_throwsNullPointerException_ifEmailIsNull
methods.description: Tests that passing null to isEmailInUse throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: returnTrueIfEmailInUse
methods.description: Checks that isEmailInUse returns true when the email exists in the repository.

methods.name: returnFalseIfEmailInUse
methods.description: Checks that isEmailInUse returns false when the email does not exist in the repository.

methods.name: changeUserEmail_throwsIncorrectPasswordException_ifPasswordIncorrect
methods.description: Ensures that an incorrect password during email change throws IncorrectPasswordException.

methods.name: changeUserEmail_throwsUserAlreadyRegisteredException_ifPasswordIncorrect
methods.description: Ensures that attempting to change email to the same current email throws UserAlreadyRegisteredException.

methods.name: changeUserPassword_throwsNullPointerException_ifUserIsNull
methods.description: Tests that passing null as user to changeUserPassword throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: changeUserPassword_throwsNullPointerException_ifPasswordIsNull
methods.description: Tests that passing null as password to changeUserPassword throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: changeUserPassword_encodesPassword_beforeSaving
methods.description: Verifies that the new password is encoded before saving the user.

methods.name: deleteUserById_deletesUser_ifUserExists
methods.description: Tests that deleting an existing user calls deleteAll on books and deleteById on user repository.

methods.name: deleteUserById_throwsNotFound_IfUserDoesNotExist
methods.description: Ensures that deleting a non-existent user throws ResponseStatusException with appropriate message.

methods.name: resetFailAttempts_setsFailedAttemptsToZero
methods.description: Checks that resetFailAttempts sets failed attempts to zero and saves the user.

methods.name: lock_setsToTrue_andSetsLockTime
methods.description: Verifies that lock sets the user as locked, sets lock time, and saves the user.
